text: The price of gold reacts to changing economic conditions and the level of economic confidence.
Periods of economic downturn and uncertainty, such as 2008–9 and 2010, produce major changes
in the gold price. This can be seen in Fig. 1 which shows the nominal and real price of gold
between 1970 and 2010. The real prices are in terms of 1970 prices, which is the base year.
